title: Score HUD wraps to two lines at 5+ digits on a 390px phone
steps: Play until score reaches 10,000 or more (a greedy tapper gets there in about 40 s)
expected: Score stays on one line in its HUD box
actual: A 5-digit score splits ('2444' / '0', '7670' / '0'), the box grows and the HUD row jumps; a 6-digit score would be worse. .stat strong uses overflow-wrap:anywhere

area: Pixel Pop / Echo Garden result card
title: Result card has no tap guard: a mashing finger skips the results (Stack has one)
steps: Phone 390x844, play a round in Pop or Echo
Keep tapping the board as the timer ends
The result card (y158-667) covers the whole board (y193-593); Play again / Replay seed sit under the finger
Programmatic check: end(), then click #again immediately starts a new round
expected: Taps landing in the first ~450 ms are swallowed, as in Stack (stack.js:197)
actual: Play again / Replay seed fire instantly, so the player never sees score, medals, share code. MMMiniKit holdMs only gates the R/Enter keys, not clicks
suspect: game/games/pop/pop.js:279, game/games/echo/echo.js:235, game/shared/mm-minikit.js:177 (Stack fix at game/games/stack/stack.js:197 is not shared)

title: Floating '+45 IN BLOOM!' text overprints the flower name labels and the centre tune/leaves widget
steps: Phone 390x844, play Echo Garden, echo the 3-note tune correctly
Look at the board while the float text rises
expected: Score popup readable, away from labels
actual: Text is drawn at the board centre where the tune progress bar and leaves sit, so it overlaps 'RED TULIP' / 'SUN DAISY' and the widget for about 1 s; garbled

title: Chain preview badge and hint can over-promise (comment says real chain can only be longer; it can be shorter)
steps: Run bestMove() before each tap over 60 seeds x 80 taps and compare the predicted chain with the real chain returned by tap()
actual: In 116 of 4800 taps (2.4%) the real chain was shorter, e.g. predicted x6 got x5. A refilled twin can turn a 4 group into a 5 group (Big pop, +2 levels), which skips the matching neighbour

title: Back-to-back near-miss floats overlap into unreadable doubled text
steps: Drop two blocks 10-12 px off in quick succession
actual: '13 PX FROM PERFECT' and '11 PX FROM PERFECT' drift on top of each other (floats live 1.25 s) and the falling debris overlaps the tower top

title: Perfect window is a fixed 5 px while block speed climbs to 340 px/s: late Perfects (and the 40 floors medal) become luck
steps: At 340 px/s one 60 Hz frame moves 5.7 px, equal to the whole +-5 px window
expected: Perfect window scales or the cap is gentler
actual: From about floor 25 the Perfect is a single-frame target; phone input latency is larger than that. Overhang math itself verified correct (cuts, snap, widen +10 at combo>=3, cap 220)

title: Only one ghost is kept: any run on a different course replaces the ghost of your best course, even a 20 m crash
steps: Run course A to 400 m (ghost saved)
Press New course, crash at 20 m
expected: Keep the better ghost, or keep one per course
actual: save.ghost is overwritten whenever run.seed differs, so the 400 m ghost is lost and the next Play races a 20 m ghost

title: On a 390x844 phone the result card starts at y~600, below the fold; PB / medals / share code need a scroll
actual: Big Run again button is shown, but the card with stats, personal best line, medals and share code is cut off at the bottom

title: Intro and result overlays cover the page header and half of the Sound button
actual: Card starts at y~52 and overlaps the title bar and the SOUND ON button; the bottom of the board and DROP button stay visible beside it

title: Medals fall in round 1 for a greedy player, weak one-more-try pull; +5 s bonus can be wasted
steps: Greedy bot (always the best predicted group) plays one round
actual: One round gave 76,700 points, chain x6, tile 10 and three medals (chain5, tile9, score25k). run.time = min(ROUND, time+5) also throws the bonus away when more than 85 s remain

title: window.__dash.course getter is shadowed by the course() function; Stack/Dash expose no sfx cue log
expected: Current course object (the getter) and a lastSound/cues hook like Pop and Echo have
actual: Returns the generator function because the later 'course' key replaces the get course() accessor; no way to verify jump/land/perfect/coin/drop cues without hearing them
